does: Returns, as a float 0..1, the chance that a spell's roll condition passes for a condition context, after the caster's spell modifications; advantage and disadvantage are folded in. Arguments: RCX the eoc::spell::Condition, RDX the ls::thoth::shared::ContextData, R8 a pointer to the spell's FixedString (SpellPrototype+0x8), R9 the caster's eoc::spell::ModificationContainerComponent or null, [rsp+0x28] RPGStats, [rsp+0x30] the ls::thoth::shared::Machine. Without a modification for the spell it is eoc::CalculateStaticSpellConditionChance(RCX, RDX, machine).
